title: Korean-Style BBQ Beef
description: A gluten-free, Korean-inspired BBQ beef recipe. Marinate beef in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and sugar, then grill to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy sauce, garlic, sugar, ginger, and chili flakes.
Blend until smooth, then transfer the marinade to a large bowl.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the beef from the marinade and shake off any excess.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang and brown sugar.
Brush the glaze over the beef during the last minute of grilling.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with green onions and additional gochujang glaze, if desired.
